description: Quote the exact Gold price to split one of the user's 3D models into parts or fill its hidden surfaces: method shape (Tripo Segment), name (Tripo Smart Segment, GLB models only, optional hint), fill (Tripo Mesh Complete fills hidden surfaces) or seal (Tripo Mesh Complete closes the holes quickly). Parts have generic names. Price by method: shape 55 Gold, name 75 Gold, fill 125 Gold, seal 95 Gold. Returns gold_cost and quote_token without starting a job or charging Gold. After the user approves, call chargen_edit_3d_split with the same inputs and quote_token.

granularity.description: shape with segment_version v2.0 only: how finely to split (default balanced).

hint.description: name only: optional guidance for the parts, for example "sword, shield, helmet".

method.description: shape: split by shape (Tripo Segment). name: split into named kinds of part (Tripo Smart Segment, GLB models only). fill: fill hidden surfaces (Tripo Mesh Complete). seal: close the holes quickly (Tripo Mesh Complete quick cap).

model_id.description: A 3D model from the user's own gallery: an image_id from chargen_search_gallery with media_type model_3d, or a finished 3D job's image_id.

part_granularity.description: name only: how finely to split (default medium).

segment_version.description: shape, fill and seal: the segmentation version (default v1.0).

split_by_connectivity.description: shape with segment_version v2.0 only: also split pieces that do not touch.

name: chargen_quote_3d_split
title: Quote 3D split
